audience: sales teams that keep people, organizations and deals in Agendor

useCases.title: Review the open deals of a funnel
useCases.text: List the funnels and their deal stages. Then list deals by stage, owner or status.

useCases.title: Find a person and the deals linked to them
useCases.text: Search people by name or email. Open one to read its organization, then list the deals linked to that person.

useCases.title: Review an organization and its tasks
useCases.text: Search organizations by name or CNPJ. Open one, then list the tasks linked to it.

useCases.title: Add a new person and organization
useCases.text: Create an organization, then create a person. Only the name is required for each record.

useCases.title: Open a deal and move it through the funnel
useCases.text: Create a deal linked to a person. Then move it to another stage of its funnel.

useCases.title: Close a deal as won or lost
useCases.text: Set a deal to won, or to lost with a reason. List the loss reasons to find the reason id.
